data.title: 春寺由梨亚 · 雨夜车厢的密语与摘镜揉眸
data.description: 【春寺由梨亚 · 雨夜车厢的密语与摘镜揉眸】停泊在无人海滨防波堤旁的黑色公务轿车内，车窗玻璃上爬满了细密的雨滴。JB坐在驾驶位上，单手搭在方向盘上。她将鼻梁上的红框眼镜摘下放在仪表台上，抬手轻轻揉捏着发酸的鼻梁与眼角，蜂蜜色的金卷发散落在肩头。封闭车厢内弥漫着私密的香水余香，她侧过身，深蓝色的美眸在暗光中带着深沉的叹息与化不开的柔情注视着身旁——「今天辛苦你了……回到我身边就好。今晚……去我那里过夜吧？」
data.location: 停在海滨防波堤旁的黑色轿车封闭车厢内
data.action: 坐在驾驶座单手搭方向盘，摘下红框眼镜轻轻揉捏鼻梁，侧身深情无奈凝视
data.lighting: 仪表盘微弱冷蓝背光与车窗外路灯在雨水流淌玻璃上的斑驳虚化光斑
data.camera: medium close-up, passenger seat pov, intimate cinematic car interior
data.promptProse: A deeply emotional and cinematic anime illustration of Harudera Yuria (JB) from The Fruit of Grisaia resting inside her car on a rainy night. Parked by the quiet seaside with raindrops streaking the glass, she sits in the driver's seat having set her red-framed glasses onto the dashboard, gently pinching the bridge of her nose in weary relief. Her wavy honey-blonde hair frames her exquisite, bare face, her beauty mark highlighted by soft dashboard illumination. Turning to gaze affectionately with striking, tender blue eyes, she conveys profound devotion and romantic warmth. Moody rain reflections, soft cinematic lighting, delicate anime coloring, no text.
